answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 164769 Country: India Title: Husband's property distribution to wife and his mother Question: According to Shariah, what percentage of a person's property divided between his wife and his mother. He has no child when he died. He left behind him wife, two young brother, one elder sister and mother. Answer ID: 164769 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1529/1322/L=01/1440) In the question mentioned above the property of deceased person shall be divided into 60 shares and distributed among his heirs. Out of the total, 15 shares shall go to his wife, 10 shares to his mother and 14-14 shares to each brother while each sister shall get 7 shares. The detail of Shariah division is as follows: Wife: 1 x 15 = 15 Mother: 1 x 10 = 10 Brothers: 2 x 14 = 28 Sister: 1 x 07 = 07 Total 60 shares The answer is correct provided the grandfather of the deceased person had died before him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
